Codebase review 2026-10-05 on main 3b2211a7bba7fb5699bd7fef3f9bb078bb6866a8. Classification: unimplemented.

MethodsDraft is held in app state keyed by FigureId and FigureSpec has no methods field, so it cannot survive document save/reopen.

Evidence:
- studio/app/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/app/figures/FigureMethods.scala:60 stores drafts: Map[FigureId, MethodsDraft]
- studio/core/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/core/document/Reporting.scala:307-325 FigureSpec has no draft field

Remaining / next action: Add a versioned FigureSpec field, codecs/pins/migration, and persistence round-trip tests.

Disposition: Keep open.
